title: Tailwise Grooming Salon Pass Terms — Cancellation by the Customer
content:
**Clause 1 — Who may cancel.** Only the customer can cancel a Tailwise Grooming Salon pass. This covers the prepaid passes and Groom Club Monthly alike.

**Clause 2 — Status at the request.** The pass status is active or suspended when the cancellation is requested, as shown on the pass record.

| Pass status when the customer asks to cancel | Cancellation may proceed |
|---|---|
| active | yes |
| suspended | yes |
| exhausted, expired or cancelled | no |

**Clause 3 — Where refunds go.** Refunds go to the original payment.

**Clause 4 — Former full-refund clause (no longer in force).** The former clause giving a full refund only where the cancellation was requested within the full-refund window after the purchase date and no visit had been used, with that window counted in calendar days from the purchase date as day 0 and a request on the last day in time, is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis for refunds on cancelled prepaid passes and by the current basis for settling a Groom Club Monthly cancellation.

**Clause 5 — Former partial-refund clause (no longer in force).** The former clause setting any other refund as the price paid less every used visit at the single-visit price for the size class at purchase, less the refund admin fee, never below zero, with the unused visits removed, is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis for refunds on cancelled prepaid passes.

**Clause 6 — Former club cancellation clause (no longer in force).** The former clause stating that Groom Club Monthly is not refunded for the current month, takes effect according to the club's cancellation timing and is charged the early termination fee when cancelled before the minimum term of billed months, is no longer in force as written here. It has been superseded by the current basis for settling a Groom Club Monthly cancellation.

**Reading the status clause (hypothetical)**

- A Groom Club Monthly member whose club is suspended for an unpaid month asks to cancel: the status is suspended, so the cancellation may proceed.
- A customer whose Bath & Tidy Pass 4-Visit shows exhausted asks to cancel it: the pass is neither active nor suspended, so it is not cancelled.

superseded_clauses: A full refund is given only if the cancellation is requested no later than full_refund_window_days after the pass's purchase date and no visit has been used.

Otherwise the refund is the price paid minus every used visit (groom_msr_visits_used) at the single_visit_price_by_size_usd for the size class at purchase, minus refund_admin_fee_usd, and never below 0.00; the unused visits are removed.

Groom Club Monthly is not refunded for the current month: a cancellation takes effect per club_cancel_effective, and a cancellation before club_min_term_months billed months (groom_msr_billed_months) is charged club_early_termination_fee_usd.
